_readme: When each data source on the site needs checking. scripts/check-refresh-calendar.py reads this file: the weekly GitHub Action (.github/workflows/data-refresh-reminder.yml) opens or updates one issue listing items due in the next 7 days or overdue, and closes it when nothing is due. After refreshing an item (or confirming nothing changed), run `python3 scripts/check-refresh-calendar.py --done <id>` to stamp lastChecked and move nextDue forward by its cadence; use --next YYYY-MM-DD to set a specific date instead. how: 'auto' = a workflow already opens a PR (the entry is a check that it ran); 'manual' = someone looks up the new figure. cadence: monthly | quarterly | semiannual | yearly.

items.item: U.S. state electricity rates (EIA Table 5.6.A)
items.notes: Workflow update-electricity-rates.yml runs on the 28th and opens a PR. If no 'auto/' PR ever appears, check repo Settings → Actions → General → 'Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests'.

items.item: EU household electricity prices (Eurostat nrg_pc_204)
items.notes: Workflow update-eu-rates.yml runs on the 5th. New half-years appear around April/May and October/November. When it updates, also update Spain, Italy, Greece, Cyprus and Malta in europeRates.json (same series).

items.notes: Cap for Jan 1–Mar 31, 2027 is announced late November. VAT removal on electricity runs to Mar 31, 2027.
